description: GS2 — Entity Resolution golden set (spec §8). Seeded user entities + a vague reference → expected resolved id OR 'ambiguous → disambiguate'. Includes deliberate near-collisions. A silent wrong-resolution is a CRITICAL failure; failing to disambiguate close candidates is critical too.

entities.name: NEPSE Portfolio
entities.description: Nepal stock exchange share trading tracker and portfolio

entities.name: Ram
entities.description: my older brother Ram who lives in Pokhara

entities.name: Sita
entities.description: my colleague Sita from the data team at work

entities.name: Fitness Log
entities.description: gym workout and running training log

cases.known_violation: V-ENTITY-1: entity resolution applies no minimum-similarity floor, so an unrelated phrase ('weather') still resolves to the nearest entity (e.g. a person) instead of returning no match. Downstream §10 injects it as a resolved entity. Needs a score floor or a relevance gate.

cases.phrase: ask Sita from the data team
